score-keeper.title: Score Keeper
score-keeper.description: A Paper 26.2/26.3 scoring engine with named buckets, custom reporting, shutdown-persisted scores and archives, high-score runs, player commands, and a main-thread API for companion plugins.

platforms.name: Paper
platforms.info: Paper 26.2 and 26.3; Java 25 required. Bukkit and Spigot servers are not supported.

features: Named score buckets with custom units, initial values, and reporting policies
UUID-keyed integer scores with default and per-player bucket selection
Player, bucket, and all-bucket archives with score resets
Target-score, timed, and manually stopped high-score runs with top-N results
Optional pre-run score snapshots and restoration
Player commands and a main-thread API for companion plugins
